meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果AI助手常因上下文丢失而中断工作
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans with files to survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI agent often loses work due to context clearing

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在项目目录中创建并维护 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md 三个文件，作为持久化工作记忆。每次对话开始或 /clear 后，它会自动恢复这些文件中的计划、发现和进度。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划这个项目，创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会生成任务计划文件。

say.text: 把刚才的发现记录到 findings.md。
say.note: Claude 会将新发现写入 findings.md。

say.text: 更新 progress.md，标记当前阶段完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three files (task_plan.md, findings.md, progress.md) in your project directory as persistent working memory. It automatically recovers plans, findings, and progress from these files after each conversation start or /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Plan this project and create task_plan.md.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a task plan file.
Claude will write the discovery to findings.md.

say_en.text: Update progress.md, mark current phase done.
say_en.note: Claude will update the progress file.
